title: Call for Papers| Preventing Chronic Disease | CDC
content: Call for Papers Print Minus Related Pages PCD Welcomes Papers Addressing Persistent Public Health Challenges Preventing Chronic Disease (PCD) is inviting manuscripts addressing persistent public health challenges. Authors are encouraged to look at the areas of interest listed below and submit manuscripts at any time. Manuscripts submitted on these topics will be given the journal’s immediate attention. The manuscripts can be of any article type used by the journal. Manuscripts must follow the instructions for PCD’s article types . Additional information about submitting manuscripts is in the Author’s Corner on PCD’s website. Corresponding authors may want to submit an inquiry to the journal in advance of submitting a manuscript to determine the suitability of the manuscript for PCD. Improving Rural Health: Solutions for Persistent Rural Public Health Challenges (Due June 15, 2026) Students Have Their Say: Novel Approaches and Solutions to Current and Emerging Public Health Problems (Due June 26, 2026) The opinions expressed by authors contributing to this journal do not necessarily reflect the opinions of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, the Public Health Service, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, or the authors’ affiliated institutions. Last Reviewed: May 28, 2026, 12:00 AM Source: National Center for Chronic Disease Prevention and Health Promotion
